spindle.observe.DeadLetter.title: DeadLetter
spindle.observe.DeadLetter.description: One command a binding or a periodic binding invoked whose last attempt was refused or did not execute, and that its binding did not escalate, kept in the store of the component that accepts it: with `--drop-retries` too, and after the retries of a binding that retries. A binding whose input was unmet ran no attempt and keeps none. The command's input is kept with it for its replay (`POST /api/dead-letters/replay`) and never listed: like `RefusedBound`, an entry names the error and never a value of its fields. A dead letter survives a restart on the same state, is no event (`GET /api/events` never lists it), is replayed at most once, and is forgotten by a reset (`POST /api/reset`). Spindle's own (`docs/design/spindle.md` § 11, dead letters).

id.description: Its id in its component's store, which a replay names with the component; ids grow and are never reused while the store is kept.

component.description: The component that accepts the command and keeps the dead letter.

binding.description: The binding id, of an event binding or a periodic one.

event.description: The qualified name of the event the binding carried; absent for a periodic binding's command.

command.description: The qualified name of the command.

outcome.description: The refusing outcome the model selected; absent where the kernel rejected it.

error.description: The qualified name of the error the refusing outcome declares, or, where the kernel rejected the command, the kind of its error, as `spindle_command_failures_total` labels it.

attempts.description: How many times it was run, the last included: more than 1 only where the binding retries; 1 for a replay that was kept again.

spindle.observe.DeadLetters.title: DeadLetters
spindle.observe.DeadLetters.description: The answer of `GET /api/dead-letters`, a console route of a served run, answered on the host's thread: every dead letter that waits for a replay, component by component in name order, each component's by id.
